documentation.file_docstring: Agent OS Copilot Extension Main entry point for the GitHub Copilot Extension. Provides safety verification for Copilot suggestions. Features: - Agent creation from natural language - 50+ agent templates - Policy-aware code suggestions - CMVK multi-model verification - Compliance checking (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, PCI DSS) - GitHub Actions deployment
